tickets.title: Raise Velvet Acorn Custody monthly checking transfer
tickets.text: Increase the monthly checking transfer from Velvet Acorn Custody to Teacup Comet Bank checking for Liora Pebblefizz from $3,500 to $4,200 starting next cycle, keeping the balance above the $20,000+ preferred level.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2024-07-24 to raise Velvet Acorn Custody monthly checking transfer $3,500-to-$4,200 next cycle.

tickets.title: File $3,500 versus $4,200 utilities figure
tickets.text: File the $3,500 figure against Liora Pebblefizz's approximately $4,200 utilities and home-maintenance costs, which supplement pension and Social-Security income from the Teacup Comet Bank checking account.
tickets.evidence: By 2024-07-26, support is needed: file $3,500 versus Liora’s about-$4,200 utilities/home-maintenance.
